arguments.command:
cd /workspace && for seed in 0 1 2; do for mode in route admit; do
python3 -c "
import sys, json; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import max_stress
open('/tmp/max_${seed}_${mode}.json','w').write(json.dumps(max_stress.build($seed, '$mode'), separators=(',',':')))
"; done; done; ls -la /tmp/max_*.json && /usr/bin/time -v env LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/workspace/native PYTHONPATH=/workspace/.deps:/workspace/submission python3 -B submission/main.py < /tmp/max_0_route.json > /tmp/maxout.json 2>/tmp/maxtime.txt; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "Elapsed|Maximum resident" /tmp/maxtime.txt; ls -la /tmp/maxout.json
